description: Normative Place.kind vocabulary and custodian internality of acceptance fixtures (contracts/fixture-place-kinds.md). Aligned with the product vocabulary of docs/execution/s2-inventory/contracts.md (moveQuantity) and the read-only custody rule of backend QualityEligibility.custody/FulfillmentCommands.requireWarehouse. ./verify prepare (ContractValidator.placeKindProblems) rejects a fixture Place without a kind, a kind outside this list an internal-storage segment without an internal custodian and (ContractValidator.receiptCustodyProblems) a direct receipt whose stock is later reserved, picked, dispatched or moved without an explicit, evidenced internal receiving custodian.
productRefs: docs/execution/s2-inventory/contracts.md (moveQuantity: both Place.kind INTERNAL_STORAGE and a confirmed internal custodian)

backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/application/quality/QualityEligibility.java (custody: INTERNAL_STORAGE+internal custodian CONFIRMED; TRANSIT/CUSTOMER/SUPPLIER/EXTERNAL_* OUTSIDE; any other kind UNRECOGNIZED -> UNKNOWN, eligible 0)
backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/domain/inventory/InventoryRepository.java (internalCustodian: an actor of the organization of kind HUMAN or AGENT)

backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/application/trade/receipt/ReceiptCommands.java (confirmReceipt: optional receivingCustodianId only on a direct receipt; an internal HUMAN/AGENT with current confirmReceipt authority for the receipt's TARGET/ITEM/PLACE/WORK; the verified receipt chains that state custody must name the same custodian, else HELD EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED/EVIDENCE_CONFLICT; a transit receipt keeps the transit leaf's custody and rejects the slot)

kinds.meaning: Controlled internal storage of the fixture organization (warehouse). Stock here is in confirmed custody only when its segment names an internal custodian; only then can other conditions make it sale/dispatch eligible.
In transport (vessel, truck, carrier leg). Held history, never sale-eligible stock; eligibility is a known 0.
A customer's place (delivered or customer site). Outside internal custody; eligibility is a known 0.
A supplier's or origin place before handover. Outside internal custody; eligibility is a known 0.
A port, customs or bonded area outside internal custody (declared EXTERNAL_* kind). Eligibility is a known 0.

unrecognizedKindControl.meaning: Explicit negative control: the Place deliberately carries a kind outside this vocabulary (not starting with EXTERNAL_) so the case can assert that the product reports eligibility UNKNOWN with eligible 0 instead of a known 0 or a positive quantity. Only allowed with that kind; a fixture never relies on an undeclared kind.

directReceiptCustody.meaning: A confirmReceipt that does not confirm an existing fixture QuantitySegment (a direct receipt: no transit leaf whose custody it could keep) creates stock whose custodian comes only from the command slot. Without it the received segment has no custodian, so a conforming product rejects reserve/pick/dispatch/move of that stock with SCOPE_INELIGIBLE and reports its eligibility UNKNOWN. A case that later uses that stock names the receiving custodian explicitly (step2r round 7).
rules: The slot names a fixture alias of an internalCustodianAliasTypes type that is a fixture actor holding confirmReceipt in roleCapabilities and grant.actions, with the receipt place in its grant place scope when that scope lists places.

At least one DocumentVersion alias the receipt cites (slot evidenceId or request evidenceRefs) names the same alias in fixtureContent.receivingCustodianAlias, none names another, and the fixture evidence sha256 of a naming alias is the SHA-256 of its canonical content (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8). The adapter installs that alias as receivingCustodianId of the original and of the event payload.

Every confirmReceipt of the same receipt (same canonicalOccurrenceKey, else the same commandIdempotencyKey) carries the same slot value or none, so a retry or a duplicate source cannot change custody.
A transit receipt (one that names an existing fixture QuantitySegment) never carries the slot; it keeps the leaf's custodian.
